name: PHYSICS
description: PHYSICS is a comprehensive benchmark for university-level physics problem solving, covering six core areas of physics. It measures advanced physics knowledge and mathematical reasoning through 1297 expert-annotated problems with an automated evaluation system.
reputation: A recent university-level physics benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating advanced scientific reasoning, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on university-level physics problems across multiple core physics domains; uses automated evaluation; highlights challenges for foundation models.
